title: 眼不見，心不念
titleEn: Out of Sight, Out of Mind
imageAlt: A dog plays with a tennis ball while a bone lies hidden under the sofa, illustrating ‘Out of Sight, Out of Mind’.
imageAltZh: 小狗只顧玩眼前的網球，沒有留意梳化底下的骨頭，呈現「眼不見，心不念」的意思。
imageCaption: The hidden bone is no longer in the dog’s sight and is therefore no longer receiving its attention.
imageCaptionZh: 骨頭藏到梳化底下，不再出現在小狗眼前，也就不再受到牠注意。

examples.en: Once Lucas put the unfinished form in a drawer, it was out of sight, out of mind for him.
examples.zh: Lucas 把未完成的表格放進抽屜後，便因看不見而把它拋諸腦後。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

meaning.en: When a person, object, duty or problem is no longer seen or regularly noticed, people may easily forget it or stop giving it attention.
meaning.zh: 當一個人、一件物件、一項責任或一個問題不再出現在眼前，或不再經常受到注意時，人們便可能很容易忘記它，或不再把它放在心上。
naturalZh: 因為不再接觸而逐漸淡忘
因為事情被收起或隱藏而不再注意
meaning.tendencyEn: The proverb describes a common tendency rather than an absolute rule. It does not mean that everybody always forgets an absent person or hidden object.
meaning.tendencyZh: 這個諺語描述一種常見傾向，而不是絕對規律；它並不表示所有人總會忘記不在身邊的人或被收藏起來的物件。

modelExample.sourceEn: After Lucas put the unfinished form in a drawer, he forgot about it.
modelExample.sourceZh: Lucas 把未完成的表格放進抽屜後，便忘記了它。
modelExample.answerEn: Once Lucas put the unfinished form in a drawer, it was out of sight, out of mind for him.
modelExample.answerZh: Lucas 把未完成的表格放進抽屜後，便因看不見而把它拋諸腦後。
modelExample.highlight: out of sight, out of mind
preservedEn: Lucas as the person who forgot it
modelExample.compressedEn: He could no longer see the form, so he forgot about it.
modelExample.compressedZh: 他不再看見表格，因此把它忘記。

register.summaryEn: The proverb is neutral and widely understood. Its tone changes according to the context.
register.summaryZh: 這個諺語屬中性及普遍使用的表達；實際語氣會隨語境而改變。
communicativeFunctionsEn: explain why somebody has forgotten a person, object, task or problem
describe how attention fades when something is no longer visible or regularly mentioned
criticise people or organisations for ignoring distant or hidden problems
explain why friendships or relationships may weaken after people stop seeing each other
describe a practical method of avoiding temptation or distraction by putting something away
communicativeFunctionsZh: 解釋某人為甚麼忘記了一個人、一件物件、一項工作或一個問題
說明某件事不再出現在眼前或不再經常被提及後，關注如何逐漸減少
批評個人或機構忽略偏遠、隱蔽或不顯眼的問題
說明人們停止見面後，友誼或關係可能逐漸變淡
說明把誘惑或令人分心的東西收起來，從而減少自己想起它的實際做法

tones.en: The speaker simply explains why something was forgotten.
tones.zh: 說話者只是解釋某件事為甚麼被忘記。

tones.en: The speaker hides sweets, a phone or a shopping application to avoid thinking about it.
tones.zh: 說話者把糖果、電話或購物應用程式收起，避免自己經常想起它。

tones.en: The speaker criticises managers, the public or an organisation for ignoring people or problems that are not immediately visible.
tones.zh: 說話者批評管理層、公眾或機構忽略沒有出現在眼前的人或問題。

sensitiveContextsEn: a serious social or safety problem
sensitiveContextsZh: 一位覺得被遺忘的朋友
嚴重的社會或安全問題
register.sensitivityEn: Saying the proverb directly to somebody who feels forgotten may sound cold or uncaring. In sensitive situations, use it to criticise neglect rather than to mock the affected person.
register.sensitivityZh: 直接對一位感到被遺忘的人說這個諺語，可能令人覺得冷漠或無情。在敏感情況下，它較適合用來批評遺忘或忽略的行為，而不是取笑受影響的人。
register.formalEn: The proverb is suitable for general communication, but a plain explanation may be clearer in highly formal or sensitive writing.
register.formalZh: 這個諺語適合一般溝通；在高度正式或敏感的文字中，直接說明因為不再看見而減少關注，可能更加清楚。

fixedVariable.variableZh: 諺語內部沒有任何可變部分。學生只需要改變諺語外圍的句子結構。

forms.example: Food at the back of the fridge is often out of sight, out of mind for Daniel.
forms.exampleZh: 對丹尼爾來說，雪櫃後方的食物往往看不見便忘記。
forms.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

forms.example: Winter clothes in the top cupboard are out of sight, out of mind for Harper during summer.
forms.exampleZh: 夏天時，哈珀不會看到高櫃裏的冬季衣物，也不會想起它們。
forms.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

forms.example: The old email was out of sight, out of mind for Ethan after he moved it to another folder.
forms.exampleZh: 伊森把舊電郵移到另一個資料夾後，便因不再看到它而忘記了。
forms.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

forms.example: For the manager, files in the bottom drawer were often out of sight, out of mind.
forms.exampleZh: 對經理來說，底層抽屜裏的文件常常因看不見而被忘記。
forms.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

forms.example: The shopping list has been out of sight, out of mind for Ruby since it fell behind the desk.
forms.exampleZh: 購物清單掉到書桌後面後，露比一直沒有再想起它。
forms.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

forms.example: The notice may become a case of out of sight, out of mind for the staff.
forms.exampleZh: 通告對員工來說可能會變成眼不見、心不念的情況。
forms.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

forms.example: The night team can be out of sight, out of mind for managers who visit only during the day.
forms.exampleZh: 對只在日間到訪的經理來說，夜班團隊可能因見不到而被忽略。
forms.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

specificForms.formula: Person / object / problem + be + out of sight, out of mind + for somebody.
specificForms.highlight: out of sight, out of mind
specificForms.descriptionEn: The verb be changes according to the subject and time.
specificForms.descriptionZh: be 動詞會按照主語和時間而改變。

examples.en: The old files were out of sight, out of mind for the manager.
examples.zh: 對經理來說，舊文件因不在眼前而被忘記。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

notes.en: Possible be forms include is, are, was, were, has been, may be and can be.
notes.zh: 可使用的 be 動詞形式包括 is、are、was、were、has been、may be 及 can be。

specificForms.formula: For + person/group, + subject + be + out of sight, out of mind.
specificForms.highlight: out of sight, out of mind
specificForms.descriptionEn: The opening phrase clearly identifies who is forgetting or ignoring the subject.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 開首短語清楚指出是誰忘記或忽略該人或事物。

examples.en: For the children, the sweets were out of sight, out of mind.
examples.zh: 對孩子們來說，糖果看不見便不會想起。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

specificForms.formula: Once / When + something disappears or is put away, + it + be + out of sight, out of mind.
specificForms.highlight: out of sight, out of mind
specificForms.descriptionEn: Use once or when to connect the change in visibility with the later loss of attention.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 使用 once 或 when，把事物不再可見的轉變與其後關注減少連繫起來。

examples.en: Once the photograph was put in a box, it was out of sight, out of mind for Leo.
examples.zh: 照片放進盒子後，里奧便把它忘記了。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

specificForms.formula: It + be/become + a case of out of sight, out of mind.
specificForms.highlight: out of sight, out of mind
specificForms.descriptionEn: Use a case of when describing a clear example of the proverb.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 當某個情況明顯反映這個諺語時，可以使用 a case of。

examples.en: Once the complaint was filed away, it became a case of out of sight, out of mind.
examples.zh: 投訴被歸檔後，便成了眼不見、心不念的情況。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

specificForms.formula: Subject + may / might / could / can / will + be/become + out of sight, out of mind.
specificForms.highlight: out of sight, out of mind
specificForms.descriptionEn: The modal must preserve the original degree of certainty.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 情態動詞必須保留原句的確定程度。

examples.en: Without regular updates, the problem could become out of sight, out of mind.
examples.zh: 如果沒有定期更新，人們可能會逐漸忘記這個問題。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

specificForms.formula: Situation + does not have to mean + out of sight, out of mind.
specificForms.highlight: out of sight, out of mind
specificForms.descriptionEn: This form shows that the proverb describes a tendency, not an unavoidable result.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個句式說明該諺語只是一種常見情況，並非必然結果。

examples.en: Moving away does not have to mean out of sight, out of mind.
examples.zh: 搬走並不一定代表看不見便會忘記。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

specificForms.formula: Subject + follow/use the principle of out of sight, out of mind + by + verb-ing.
specificForms.highlight: out of sight, out of mind
specificForms.descriptionEn: This form is especially suitable for avoiding sweets, unnecessary shopping, a mobile phone, games or other distractions.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個句式尤其適合說明避開糖果、不必要的購物、手提電話、遊戲或其他令自己分心的事物。

examples.en: Zoe followed the principle of out of sight, out of mind by hiding the shopping application.
examples.zh: 佐伊把購物應用程式收起，運用了眼不見、心不念的做法。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

benefits.en: The proverb combines the ideas that something is no longer visible and is therefore forgotten in one concise expression.
benefits.zh: 這個諺語把「不再看見」和「因而忘記」兩個意思集中在一句簡潔的表達之中。

examples.en: Longer: The form was put inside a drawer. Because the manager could no longer see it, he gradually forgot about it.
examples.zh: 較長版本：表格被放進抽屜。經理因為不再看見它，便逐漸忘記了。

examples.en: Proverb: The form was out of sight, out of mind for the manager once it was put in the drawer.
examples.zh: 諺語版本：表格放進抽屜後，經理便因看不見而把它忘記。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

benefits.en: People often pay more attention to things that are visible, nearby, regularly mentioned or frequently encountered.
benefits.zh: 它說明經常出現在眼前的事物通常更容易受到注意，而被收起、遮住或不再提及的事物則容易被忘記。

benefits.titleZh: 可以批評忽視問題的行為
benefits.en: Problems in distant places may receive little attention. The proverb allows a speaker to criticise this behaviour clearly and compactly.
benefits.zh: 偏遠地方的問題可能因為不在大眾眼前而被忽略。這個諺語可以簡潔地批評這種現象。

benefits.titleEn: It Can Describe a Practical Strategy
benefits.en: People sometimes put sweets, shopping applications or mobile phones away so that they think about them less.
benefits.zh: 人們有時會把糖果、購物應用程式或電話收起來，減少自己想起它們的機會。

benefits.en: Instead of repeating a long explanation, the speaker can summarise the situation with one balanced proverb. Use it only when absence or lack of visibility genuinely causes forgetting or reduced attention.
benefits.zh: 說話者可以使用這個結構平衡、容易記憶的諺語，總結一個較長的情況。不過，只有當「不在眼前」確實導致忘記或減少關注時，才應使用。

origin.statusEn: Well Documented; Exact First Use Unknown
origin.statusZh: 有較充分記錄；確切首次用法不明

history.en: A close form appears in an English translation of Thomas à Kempis from around 1450: “Whan Man is oute of sight, son be he passith oute of mynde.” In 1546, John Heywood recorded the shorter form “Out of sight out of minde” in his collection of English proverbs. Heywood was collecting sayings already known to speakers, so the record does not prove that he personally invented the proverb.
history.zh: 一個十分接近現代版本的說法，約於1450年的 Thomas à Kempis 英文譯本中出現。到了1546年，John Heywood 在其英語諺語集內記錄了較精簡的「Out of sight out of minde」。Heywood 的工作主要是收集當時已有的諺語，因此不能單憑這項記錄便認定他創造了這個說法。

history.en: The wording gradually settled into its modern spelling and punctuation. The central idea remained the same: something that is no longer seen can easily be forgotten.
history.zh: 字詞的拼法和標點後來逐漸變成現代形式，但核心意思一直相同：不再看見的事物，很容易逐漸被人忘記。

origin.memoryEn: When something leaves your sight, it may also leave your mind.
origin.memoryZh: 當某件事物離開你的視線，也可能逐漸離開你的思想。

rules.titleZh: 不在眼前必須導致關注減少
rules.en: Use the proverb only when absence or reduced contact causes the forgetting. Do not use it when the cause is unrelated, such as extreme tiredness.
rules.zh: 如果忘記事情的原因與「看不見或不再接觸」無關，便不應使用這個諺語。

examples.en: Suitable: The bill was out of sight, out of mind for Marcus.
examples.zh: 適合：帳單被其他文件遮住，因此馬庫斯把它忘記。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

examples.en: Unsuitable: Marcus forgot the bill because he was extremely tired.
examples.zh: 不適合：馬庫斯因為非常疲倦而忘記帳單。

rules.titleEn: It Does Not Mean ‘No Longer Exists’
rules.en: The proverb means that something is forgotten or receives less attention. It does not mean that the thing has disappeared from the world.
rules.zh: 這個諺語表示某件事被忘記或不再受到注意，而不是表示該事物已經不存在。

rules.en: A temporarily hidden object does not automatically justify the proverb. The context must also show that people therefore forget, ignore or stop thinking about it.
rules.zh: 只是暫時看不見某件東西，不代表一定可以使用這個諺語。語境還必須說明人們因此忘記、忽略或不再想起它。

examples.en: Literal situation only: The cat is under the bed, so I cannot see it.
examples.zh: 只有字面情況：貓在床下，所以我看不見牠。

rules.en: Do not change the person or group who forgets the subject.
rules.zh: 不可把忘記事物的人由原句中的人物改成另一個人。

examples.en: Source: The manager forgot the complaint after it was filed away.
examples.zh: 原句：投訴被歸檔後，經理把它忘記。

examples.en: Correct: The complaint was out of sight, out of mind for the manager.
examples.zh: 正確：投訴被歸檔後，經理便把它拋諸腦後。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

examples.en: Incorrect: The complaint was out of sight, out of mind for the customer.
examples.zh: 錯誤：投訴被歸檔後，顧客便把它拋諸腦後。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

rules.en: Do not turn a possibility into a completed fact.
rules.zh: 錯誤答案不可把「可能發生」改成「已經發生」。

examples.en: Source: The staff may forget the notice.
examples.zh: 原句：員工可能會忘記通告。

examples.en: Correct: The notice may become out of sight, out of mind for the staff.
examples.zh: 正確：通告對員工來說可能會變成眼不見、心不念。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

examples.en: Incorrect: The notice was out of sight, out of mind for the staff.
examples.zh: 錯誤：通告已被員工拋諸腦後。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

rules.titleZh: 不要重複諺語已表達的意思
rules.en: Keep the context, but do not add another clause that merely says the person forgot it.
rules.zh: 較好的答案會保留情境，但不再次解釋「他忘記了電郵」。

examples.en: Poor: The email was out of sight, out of mind for Ethan, so he forgot about it.
examples.zh: 欠佳：電郵對伊森來說已是眼不見、心不念，所以他忘記了它。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

examples.en: Better: The email was out of sight, out of mind for Ethan after he moved it to another folder.
examples.zh: 較好：伊森把電郵移到另一個資料夾後，便因不再看見而忘記了它。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

rules.titleZh: 這個說法並非永遠正確
rules.en: Some people forget absent friends, while other people miss them more. The proverb expresses one possible human reaction, not a scientific law.
rules.zh: 有些人會逐漸忘記不在身邊的朋友，但另一些人可能會更加掛念他們。這個諺語只表達一種可能的人類反應，並不是科學定律。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Use It Carelessly About People
rules.titleZh: 談及人物時不可冷漠使用
rules.en: It may appropriately criticise neglect, but saying it directly to a hurt friend may sound uncaring.
rules.zh: 這個諺語可以用來批評忽視別人的行為，但直接對一位受傷的朋友說，可能顯得冷漠。

examples.en: Critical and appropriate: The manager treated the night team as out of sight, out of mind.
examples.zh: 批評式而適合：經理把夜班團隊當作看不見便不用理會。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

examples.en: Potentially insensitive: You moved away, so you are out of sight, out of mind.
examples.zh: 可能顯得冷漠：你搬走了，所以我便把你忘記。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse It with the Opposite Idea
rules.en: Out of sight, out of mind says that distance or absence causes people to forget. Absence makes the heart grow fonder says that distance or absence makes affection stronger.
rules.zh: out of sight, out of mind 表示不再見面或接觸後，人們逐漸忘記對方；absence makes the heart grow fonder 則表示分開後反而更加掛念對方。兩個諺語表達相反的可能反應。

examples.en: out of sight, out of mind: distance or absence causes people to forget
examples.zh: 眼不見，心不念：距離或缺席令人逐漸忘記
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

examples.en: absence makes the heart grow fonder: distance or absence makes affection stronger
examples.zh: 小別勝新婚：距離或分開令感情更深

rules.en: The comma shows the balance between the two halves.
rules.zh: 逗號顯示兩個部分之間的平衡，必須保留。

examples.en: Correct: Out of sight, out of mind.
examples.zh: 正確：眼不見，心不念。
examples.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

examples.en: Incorrect: Out of sight out of mind.
examples.zh: 錯誤：省略中間的逗號。
examples.highlight: out of sight out of mind

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to every item using the exact proverb “out of sight, out of mind”. Preserve the original person, object, situation, tense and certainty. Do not repeat the meaning of the proverb after using it. Begin with the supplied starter.
instructions.zh: 請使用完整諺語「out of sight, out of mind」改寫句子或完成回應。保留原句的人物、事物、情境、時態及確定程度；使用諺語後，不要再次重複「因看不見而忘記」的意思，並以指定開首作答。

questions.prompt: Noah put his model car in a cupboard and soon stopped thinking about it.
questions.promptZh: 諾亞把模型車放進櫃子後，很快便不再想起它。
questions.answer: Once Noah put the model car in a cupboard, it was out of sight, out of mind for him.
questions.answerZh: 諾亞把模型車放進櫃子後，對他來說便是「眼不見，心不念」。
questions.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

questions.prompt: Grace moved to another school. Some of her old classmates gradually stopped thinking about her.
questions.promptZh: 格蕾絲轉到另一間學校。一些舊同學漸漸不再想起她。
questions.answer: Grace was soon out of sight, out of mind for some of her old classmates after she moved to another school.
questions.answerZh: 格蕾絲轉校後，一些舊同學很快便把她拋諸腦後。
questions.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

questions.prompt: Oliver’s homework note slipped under his books, so he completely forgot it.
questions.promptZh: 奧利弗的功課便條滑到書本下面，因此他完全忘記了它。
questions.answer: Once Oliver’s homework note slipped under his books, it was out of sight, out of mind for him.
questions.answerZh: 奧利弗的功課便條滑到書本下面後，他便因看不見而把它忘記。
questions.highlight: out of sight, out of mind

questions.prompt: The parents put the sweets in the top cupboard, and the children stopped asking for them.
questions.promptZh: 父母把糖果放到高櫃裏，孩子們便不再追問糖果。
questions.answer: For the children, the sweets in the top cupboard were out of sight, out of mind.
questions.answerZh: 對孩子們來說，放在高櫃裏的糖果看不見便不再想起。
